page.overview:
Who is Tsing Cha?

Kate Cha (daughter) Paul Cha (son) Unnamed wife

Tsing Cha is a minor character in Invincible, debuting in Season 3's flashbacks.

He is the father of Dupli-Kate and Multi-Paul.

As the father of Kate and Paul, he had to deal with his children who had the gift of multiplying indefinitely while trying to support them and take care of all the children, after his wife died giving birth to them, which ended up driving him insane. After going crazy, the GDA sent him to a mental hospital and took custody of his children, training them to become assassins. Kate still visited him to see if his state changed.
